info.title: codehub API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. 401 is returned without a valid token; 404 where the caller may not read the repository, so its existence is not disclosed; 403 where the caller may read it but not take the action, naming the paths it may not write; 409 for a conflict or a lost compare-and-swap, naming the paths. Object bytes do not pass through the API: the grants it returns are used directly against the object store.

get.summary: Liveness: the process serves requests. Needs no token and depends on nothing.
Readiness: PostgreSQL and the object store each answer within 2 seconds. Needs no token.

503.description: PostgreSQL or the object store did not answer; the detail names it.

post.summary: Create an organisation, administered by the caller.

400.description: A name, path, address or body is malformed.

401.description: No valid bearer token was presented.

403.description: The decision point did not allow creating the organisation (external authorisation mode).

500.description: The server failed; the body names no internals.

post.summary: Create a repository in an organisation.

403.description: The caller is not an admin of the organisation. The organisation may not exist.

404.description: The organisation does not exist and the decision point did not allow creating it (external authorisation mode).

500.description: The server failed; the body names no internals.

paths.description: The paths a 403 or a 409 is about.

Address.description: The SHA-256 address of an object.

id.description: The repository's identity, which a decision point may name it by.

prefix.description: The directory the grant covers, components separated by `/`; empty for the whole repository.

message.description: The changeset's message; where absent or empty, the workspace's description.

labels.description: What the runner offers; a job's labels must all be among them.

repository.description: The repository's name, where the runner takes only its jobs; absent for any repository of the organisation.

heartbeat_interval.description: How often the runner heartbeats, in seconds.

exit_code.description: The command's exit code; absent where it has none.

output_tail.description: The end of the command's output.

lease_expires_at.description: While running: when the lease lapses, in seconds since the epoch.

deadline.description: While running: when the job times out, in seconds since the epoch.

revert.description: What came of reverting the changeset because this check failed or timed out; null where no revert was attempted.

paths.description: The paths the revert conflicts on; it landed nothing.

reason.description: Why the revert failed after it was reserved; it landed nothing and is not tried again.

kind.description: The file mode; a deleted path's is the base's.

download.description: A grant to download the content of an added or modified path; null for a deleted one.

base.description: The changeset the workspace is based on; null where `main` was unset.

changes.description: In path order; a path whose change leaves the base as it is is not listed.

SnapshotChange.description: `file` records a file, `delete` records a deletion, `restore` returns the path to its base.

changes.description: At most one change to a path.

unified.description: A unified diff with three lines of context.

kind_change.description: Present where the path is on both sides and its file kind differs, whatever the content does.
